raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
RADIO temporal grouping constructs scalar-tensor `max_seqlen_q` and `max_seqlen_kv` values even though `PackedSeqParams` declares integer maxima. With FlashAttention 4.0.0b34 and CUTLASS 4.8, these values fail in `cute.ceil_div` with `ValueError: Expected IntTuple, whose leaves are integers`.

Keep the maximum as the Python integer already computed from frame geometry. This preserves cumulative sequence boundaries and their dtype/device, and avoids the unnecessary scalar allocation without adding a device-to-host synchronization.

The issue affects five image/video tests in [Megatron Bridge #6258](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6258), including [the two RADIO video forwards](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/actions/runs/37924987528/job/113823958424). Add six CPU regression cases covering uniform videos, ragged videos, mixed images/odd-frame videos, and both embedder paths; also enforce integer maxima in the existing GPU metadata cases.

Validation:

- 12 targeted CPU tests passed in the 26.09 container. The six new cases all fail against the original implementation at the integer-type assertion.
- The repository formatter check passed for both changed files (Black, isort, Pylint, Ruff); whitespace checks passed. Mypy encountered an internal tool error, so type checking is not claimed as passed.
- All six existing CUDA metadata cases passed on RTX 6000 Ada with the fixed commit, covering host/CPU/CUDA geometry and both duplication modes. Cumulative boundaries retain their CUDA device and dtype, and maximum lengths are Python integers. This is metadata validation, not full-model or FA4 kernel coverage.
- The [upstream RADIO/models job](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/runs/37937170763/job/113855736895) passed all 52 RADIO cases, including all six new regressions and six strengthened metadata cases; none was skipped. This run checked out merge `41d49831` (fix `38a2399` into upstream main `204867ba`) with PyTorch 26.08, rather than the raw fork commit or Bridge's 26.09 runtime.
- [Upstream CI](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/runs/37937170763) completed successfully: all 42 unit jobs and all ten default functional jobs passed. Required CODEOWNER review remains pending; this CI result does not satisfy the human review gates.
- [Current Bridge CI](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/actions/runs/37948803805), on head `d9500bb6c` / merge `e8f2b7b4` with MCore `38a2399` and PyTorch 26.09, passed 11,737 core tests and 573 diffusion tests. Both image builds, lint, and import validation passed. All six affected GPU targets explicitly passed: the packed optimizer step (92.78 s), packed image, multiframe video, ragged rectangular video, exact rectangular image/video token counts, and vision data parallelism. None was skipped; the pin-consistency check also passed.
- All five local Bridge pin checks passed. Bridge functional tests and separate installation/release acceptance remain pending as of 2026-10-09 15:47 UTC. No attention backend, numerical tolerance, or test selection is changed by this MCore patch.

The branch starts at `441a987409b8fdd2b90b463f7999bac970109a43`, the MCore revision used by the reproducing Bridge CI run. RADIO and its test file are unchanged between that revision and current main.

     def _stub(self):
         return SimpleNamespace(patch_dim=self.PATCH_DIM, temporal_patch_dim=self.TEMPORAL_PATCH_DIM)
 
+    @pytest.mark.internal
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("skip_image_duplication", [False, True])
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
+        "num_frames,patch_grids,expected_cu_seqlens,expected_max_seqlen",
+        [
+            ([2], [(2, 2)] * 2, [0, 4], 4),
+            ([2, 2], [(2, 4)] * 2 + [(2, 6)] * 2, [0, 8, 20], 12),
+            ([1, 3], [(2, 2)] + [(2, 4)] * 3, [0, 4, 12, 20], 8),
+        ],
+        ids=["uniform-video", "ragged-videos", "image-and-odd-video"],
+    )
+    def test_packed_sequence_metadata_uses_integer_max_lengths(
+        self,
+        num_frames,
+        patch_grids,
+        expected_cu_seqlens,
+        expected_max_seqlen,
+        skip_image_duplication,
+    ):
+        """Temporal regrouping keeps host integer lengths required by attention backends."""
+        sequence_lengths = torch.tensor([h * w for h, w in patch_grids], dtype=torch.int32)
+        cu_seqlens = torch.cat((torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32), sequence_lengths)).cumsum(
+            dim=0, dtype=torch.int32
+        )
+        packed_seq_params = PackedSeqParams(
+            qkv_format="thd",
+            cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens,
+            cu_seqlens_kv=cu_seqlens,
+            max_seqlen_q=int(sequence_lengths.max()),
+            max_seqlen_kv=int(sequence_lengths.max()),
+        )
+        images = torch.zeros(1, int(cu_seqlens[-1]), 8)
+        imgs_sizes = torch.tensor(patch_grids, dtype=torch.int32) * self.PATCH_DIM
+
+        _, _, _, grouped_params, _ = RADIOViTModel._apply_temporal_grouping(
+            self._stub(),
+            images,
+            imgs_sizes,
+            num_frames,
+            packed_seq_params,
+            skip_image_duplication=skip_image_duplication,
+        )
+
+        assert type(grouped_params.max_seqlen_q) is int
+        assert type(grouped_params.max_seqlen_kv) is int
+        assert grouped_params.max_seqlen_q == expected_max_seqlen
+        assert grouped_params.max_seqlen_kv == expected_max_seqlen
+        assert grouped_params.qkv_format == "thd"
+        expected = torch.tensor(expected_cu_seqlens, dtype=cu_seqlens.dtype)
+        for cumulative_lengths in (grouped_params.cu_seqlens_q, grouped_params.cu_seqlens_kv):
+            assert cumulative_lengths.dtype == cu_seqlens.dtype
+            assert cumulative_lengths.device == cu_seqlens.device
+            assert torch.equal(cumulative_lengths, expected)
+
